description: Monitor for changes and automatically restart Node.js server.

option.name: --config
tip: Alternate nodemon.json config file to use

option.name: --cwd
tip: Change into <dir> before running the script

option.name: --delay
tip: Debounce restart for "n" seconds

option.name: --dump
tip: Print full debug configuration

option.name: --exec
tip: Execute script with "app", ie. -x "python -v"

option.name: --exitcrash
tip: Exit on crash, allows nodemon to work with other watchers

option.name: --ext
tip: Extensions to look for, ie. "js,pug,hbs"

option.name: --ignore
tip: Ignore specific files or directories

option.name: --legacy-watch
tip: Use polling to watch for changes (typically needed when watching over a network/Docker)

option.name: --no-colors
tip: Disable color output

option.name: --no-stdin
tip: Nodemon passes stdin directly to child process

option.name: --no-update-notifier
tip: Opt-out of update version check

option.name: --on-change-only
tip: Execute script on change only, not startup

option.name: --polling-interval
tip: Combined with -L, milliseconds to poll for (default 100)

option.name: --quiet
tip: Minimise nodemon messages to start/stop only

option.name: --signal
tip: Use specified kill signal instead of default (ex. SIGTERM)

option.name: --spawn
tip: Force nodemon to use spawn (over fork) [node only]

option.name: --verbose
tip: Show detail on what is causing restarts

option.name: --version
tip: Show the current nodemon version

option.name: --watch
tip: Watch directory "path" or files. Use once for each directory or file to watch

global_option.name: --help
tip: Show the help
